title: Token Efficient Task Execution via Application Behavior Modeling for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The strong performance of AI Agents across an impressive variety of tasks is driving an unprecedented investment in agentic infrastructures, however the cost of processing tokens is fast increasing. Web agents automate the execution of web-application tasks described in natural language, by analyzing the web-application's user interface (UI) and interacting with it. This work introduces OdoBot, a novel web-agent architecture that completes tasks at a fraction of the cost when compared to conventional web agents. This is achieved by leveraging a behavioral model of the underlying application constructed by analyzing successful task-execution demonstrations. Our experiments with 45 tasks on the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS) demonstrate that OdoBot uses 44% and 80% fewer tokens than two state-of-the-art competitor agents (Agent-E and WebVoyager), while also surpassing WebVoyager in terms of task success rate.

translated_title: 通过应用行为建模实现Web智能体的令牌高效任务执行
translated_abstract: AI智能体在各种任务中的强大表现正在推动对智能体基础设施的前所未有的投资，然而处理令牌的成本却在快速上升。Web智能体通过分析网络应用的用户界面（UI）并与之交互，自动化执行以自然语言描述的网络应用任务。本工作提出了OdoBot，一种新颖的Web智能体架构，能够以远低于传统Web智能体的成本完成任务。这是通过利用从分析成功任务执行演示中构建的底层应用行为模型来实现的。我们在Canvas学习管理系统（LMS）上进行的45个任务实验表明，OdoBot比两个最先进的竞争智能体（Agent-E和WebVoyager）分别少使用44%和80%的令牌，同时在任务成功率上也超越了WebVoyager。
tldr: OdoBot通过分析成功任务演示构建应用行为模型，使Web智能体在Canvas LMS上比最先进方法节省44%-80%的令牌成本，同时获得更高的任务成功率。
en_tdlr: OdoBot builds an application behavior model from successful task-execution demonstrations, enabling web agents to reduce token costs by 44-80% compared to state-of-the-art agents while achieving higher task success rates.
